name: @currentjs/router
description: Lightweight decorator-based HTTP/HTTPS server with routing,JWT authentication, and static files serving for @currentjs generated apps.
author: Konstantin Zavalny

scripts.test:all: npm run test:build && node --test dist-test/tests/unit/*.test.js dist-test/tests/integration/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:build && node --test --experimental-test-coverage dist-test/tests/unit/*.test.js dist-test/tests/integration/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage:src: npm run test:build && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude="dist-test/tests/**" dist-test/tests/unit/*.test.js dist-test/tests/integration/*.test.js
